title: Khada Parsi
note: A Parsi gentleman on a tall cast-iron pillar, standing in the road junction since the 1860s.

title: Sion Fort
note: A small 17th-century British watchtower fort on the hillock just after Sion station.

title: Thane Creek
note: The train crosses the creek on leaving Thane, with mangroves along both banks.

title: Parsik Tunnel
note: 1.3 km under Parsik hill, one of the oldest railway tunnels in India still in use (1916).

title: Mumbra Devi Temple
note: The white temple high on the hill above Mumbra, reached by a long flight of steps.

title: Matheran hills and Peb Fort
note: The flat-topped Matheran range rises on the right from Badlapur to Neral. Peb Fort sits on its northern tip.

title: Palasdari Dam
note: The lake close to the line just after Karjat, the last flat stretch before the climb.

title: Bhor Ghat begins
note: The climb of about 550 m up the Sahyadri starts here, through more than 20 tunnels. Have the camera ready from now to Khandala.

title: Waterfall
note: One of many falls on the ghat walls in the monsoon.

title: Songiri Fort
note: A small hill fort guarding the old route up the ghat.

title: Rajmachi forts
note: Twin forts Shrivardhan and Manaranjan on the ridge across the valley, built to watch over the Bor pass.

title: Waterfall
note: Monsoon falls across the valley.

title: Waterfall
note: Monsoon falls on the far side of the valley.

title: Duke's Nose
note: The pointed cliff said to look like the Duke of Wellington's nose. A favourite of rock climbers.

title: Waterfall
note: Falls just before Khandala in the monsoon.

title: Kune Falls
note: A three-step waterfall of about 200 m, among the highest in India, between Khandala and Lonavala.

title: Lohagad
note: The 'iron fort' with its scorpion-tail ridge, just behind Visapur.

title: Bhaja Caves
note: 22 Buddhist rock-cut caves from the 2nd century BC, as small dark openings in the hillside above Bhaja village.

title: Visapur Fort
note: The long flat-topped fort on the right after Malavli, built by the Peshwas in the early 1700s.

title: Ghorawadi hill and caves
note: A rocky hill with a Shiva temple and Buddhist caves near the top.

title: Mula River at Dapodi
note: The train crosses the Mula beside the old stone Harris Bridge.

title: Mula–Mutha river
note: The last river crossing, just before Pune Junction.
